(a) We have a response variable $y$ and three explanatory variables $x_1, x_2$ and $x_3$. These are stored as `Y`, `x1`, `x2` and `x3` in a data frame called `mock4a`. We give the following commands in R

```r
> (lmres <- lm(Y~x1+x2+x3, data=mock4a)) # (a)i.
